title: Lynn & Mrs Anderson, Toddler on Porch Steps - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century outdoor snapshot showing a young girl and a woman seated on the porch railing steps next to dense garden foliage, captioned on the front lower margin 'Lynn - Mrs Anderson'. The young girl wears a light dress and dark shoes while holding an object in her lap, and the woman wears a floral patterned summer dress. In the shadowed background on the porch stairs, a man in work trousers sits observing. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckle edges characteristic of 1940s and early 1950s amateur print developing.
